shown.message:
Outline rev 18 is pushed. It takes in the completed Arena-55k positive-control arm.

- **Result:** Δ was not detected in any of the 68 control rows, on either graph. The largest upper interval end is 0.078 (position bias 2, flip), well inside ±0.15.
- **Arena limit:** the control's overdispersion barely registers on the SE ratio on Arena (0.82 to 0.94, design effect 1.11). The design effect the SE ratio sees (6.2) is the MT-Bench human one. The outline now says the paper must state this wherever Arena rows appear.

The paper doesn't have the Arena rows yet. `experiment-repo` has asked `paper-repo` to add them, so I haven't raised it again. Once they're in, I'll check them against rev 18.

`experiment-repo`#9 is closed. My commitment `story-repo`#2 stays open until the final version.
